traducciones.Vas a perder los cambios que hiciste acá: You'll lose the changes you made here.
traducciones.Vas a perder los datos que ingresaste pa: You'll lose the data you entered for {variable}.
traducciones.Vas a poder cambiar cualquier color desp: You'll be able to change any color later - this is just a reference for a combination that already works well.
traducciones.Vas a recibir la alarma nativa de tu cal: You'll get your calendar's native alarm when a task, exam, or event from your Agenda is approaching - with top priority, even with the app closed. You can turn it on or off anytime from Settings.
traducciones.Ver todos los choques pendientes de reso: View all pending conflicts to resolve
traducciones.verificar que no rompa nada del flujo de: verify that it doesn't break anything in the authentication flow or normal startup
traducciones.Viene precargado el tiempo real transcur: The actual elapsed time comes pre-filled. Only change it if you really studied less.
traducciones.Vincular a una materia tuya: Link to one of your subjects
traducciones.Vista de solo lectura. Se actualiza cada: Read-only view. It updates every time you reload this page.
traducciones.Vos y quien invites compiten por horas d: You and whoever you invite compete for study hours during the week. You can invite people later by copying the link.
traducciones.Ya completaste tu meta de estudio de est: You've already completed your study goal for this week.
traducciones.Ya está revocado, esto solo borra el reg: It's already revoked, this only deletes the entry from the list. It doesn't affect anyone who had it saved.
traducciones.Ya existe una materia con ese código en: A subject with that code already exists in this plan.
